summary: Session C verification for Tile Station admin: (a) Bathroom/UFH/Tools Managers on ManagerPageShell, (b) BulkImageUploadModal, (c) Draft Recovery via useDraftRecovery, (d) Product Templates + Wizard TemplatesPicker. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (test_product_templates.py). GET /api/product-templates returns {templates,count}; POST creates doc with slug='test-template', id, created_by='admin@test.com', usage_count=0, cleaned fields; ?product_group=tiles filter returns it; /from-product with real SKU (TEST_NO_CAT_1775766472) plucks fields and excludes sku/prices/stock/images/_id; POST /{slug}/use increments usage_count to 1; DELETE soft-deletes (subsequent GET returns 404, list excludes it); POST without auth → 401/403. GET /api/manager-definitions still returns {definitions:[], count:0} — no route collision. Frontend: Login admin@test.com/admin123 OK. /admin/bathroom renders with manager-tabs-bar containing all 6 tabs (tiles, materials, flooring, bathroom, underfloor_heating, tools) — no manager-tab-ufh, no 'SOON' text; Bathroom Manager title + Bath icon; sub-tabs All Bathroom(42)/Toilets/Basins/Baths/Showers/Taps & Mixers/Accessories present with counts; bathroom-add-new-btn + bathroom-refresh-btn present. /admin/underfloor-heating: red theme, underfloor_heating-add-new-btn present, sub-tabs Heating Mats/Cables/Thermostats/Insulation. /admin/tools: slate theme, tools-add-new-btn present, sub-tabs Cutters/Trowels/Spacers & Levellers/Mixers & Buckets/Cleaning/Other. Bulk-images: click bathroom-select-all → manager-bulk-bar appears with bar-bulk-images; click → bulk-images-modal opens with bulk-images-mode-append + bulk-images-mode-replace radios. Draft Recovery: Edit first bathroom row → modal opens with bathroom-save-as-template button in footer + bathroom-draft-status; typing in Short Description + 4.5s wait → draft-status text 'Draft saved'. Close & reopen same row → bathroom-draft-restore-banner appears. Wizard TemplatesPicker: seeded bathroom template via API; opened Add Product Wizard from Bathroom Manager (preset=bathroom, opens on step 2) → wizard-templates-picker visible with 1 pill 'TEST Bathroom Template'; clicked pill → 'Prefilled from TEST Bathroom Template' toast. Regression: /admin/materials, /admin/tiles, /admin/flooring all render normally; select-all reveals bar-bulk-images in each. All backend + frontend acceptance criteria met.
